cilium: a values change rolls the agent and the operator

The agent and the operator read `cilium-config` when they start, so a
change to the chart's values only takes effect through new pods. The
values turn on the chart's `rollOutCiliumPods` and
`operator.rollOutPods`, which put a checksum of the rendered ConfigMap
on each pod template: a change that rewrites the ConfigMap rolls both,
and an `up` that leaves it alone rolls neither.

The test renders the pinned chart with the pinned Helm three times --
the component's values, the same again, and one value changed that only
the ConfigMap carries -- and holds the two pod templates to follow the
ConfigMap and nothing else.

Closes Aetf/kluster-ops#794

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

cilium: a values change rolls Envoy as well

Envoy reads its bootstrap from `cilium-envoy-config`, which the values
are rendered into, when it starts. The values turn on the chart's
`envoy.rollOutPods`, which puts that ConfigMap's checksum on the
`cilium-envoy` pod template, so a change that rewrites it rolls Envoy
as `rollOutCiliumPods` and `operator.rollOutPods` roll the agent and
the operator.

The rollout test covers the Envoy DaemonSet with a change to
`envoy.log.format`, which only the bootstrap reads.

Addresses the dispatcher's ruling on #756 that Envoy is within
Aetf/kluster-ops#794.
